title: Variable Validation
scenario: Declare bucket_name with a validation block that enforces lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and a 3-63 length.
constraints: Use can(regex(...)) or a regex() rule.
Use the variable for the bucket name.

focus.title: Complete the validation block for bucket_name
focus.todo: Add a condition and error_message that enforce the documented bucket naming rules.

hints.why: Input variables separate configuration from implementation. They let one module serve dev, staging and production without editing the resource code, and they give reviewers one obvious place to inspect change.
hints.what: Complete the marked TODO in `variables.tf`. Add a condition and error_message that enforce the documented bucket naming rules. Use the visible constraints as your checklist before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use a variable when a value differs by environment, comes from a caller, or must be supplied securely at apply time. Keep truly stable constants in locals instead.
hints.how: Open `variables.tf` and work inside the single TODO region. Change one requirement at a time: add the named block, argument or reference, then run the tests. When a check fails, match its wording to the constraints and fix only the block it names.
